help.title: Help Center
help.heroSubtitleOwner: Owner FAQ, billing and property guides
help.heroSubtitleTenant: Browse our FAQ or contact us

tenantFaq.q: How do I pay my rent?
tenantFaq.a: Go to the Payments tab and tap on your current bill. You can pay via UPI, Cashfree, or mark as paid after bank transfer. Your owner will be notified immediately.

tenantFaq.q: How do I raise a maintenance complaint?
tenantFaq.a: Tap the Complaints tab, then tap "+ New Complaint". Select a category, describe the issue, attach photos if needed, and submit. Your owner will be notified.
Your rent due date is set by your property owner — typically the 5th of every month. You will receive a push notification and email reminder 2 days before the due date.

tenantFaq.q: How do I download a rent receipt?
tenantFaq.a: Go to Payments → select a paid bill → tap the Download Receipt button. The PDF will be saved and can be shared directly from the app.

tenantFaq.q: How do I change my password?
tenantFaq.a: Go to Profile → Settings → Change Password. You will need to enter your current password first. If you forgot it, use Forgot Password on the login screen.
Your account gets locked after 5 failed login attempts for security. Wait 15 minutes and try again, or use Forgot Password to reset your credentials.
Yes. All payment data is encrypted and processed through certified payment gateways. Happy Renting never stores your card or UPI credentials.

tenantFaq.q: How do I update my profile?
tenantFaq.a: Go to the Profile tab and tap Edit Profile. You can update your name, phone number. Contact your owner to update your email or room details.

ownerFaq.q: How do I add a property?
ownerFaq.a: Go to Properties in the drawer and tap "+ Add". Enter the property name, address and city, and save. You can then add rooms and tenants to it.

ownerFaq.q: How do I add a tenant to a room?
ownerFaq.a: Open a property, tap a room, then Assign Tenant. You can also use "Add Tenant" in the drawer to create a tenant account and link them to a room.

ownerFaq.q: How do I verify a tenant rent payment?
ownerFaq.a: Go to Payments and tap "Verify" on any record awaiting verification. Confirm the proof to credit the tenant, or Reject it with a reason.

ownerFaq.q: How do I set / edit rent amounts?
ownerFaq.a: Open a room under Properties and edit the monthly rent and due date. New rent amounts apply to future bills immediately.
Go to Expenses in the drawer and tap "+" to add a new expense. Categorize it, add the amount and date; it will flow into your summary and reports.
Open the Reports screen to view collections, receivables and expenses. Use the date range picker to filter and tap Export to save as PDF.

ownerFaq.q: How do I handle a maintenance complaint?
ownerFaq.a: Go to Complaints, open a request to see photos and the tenant message, then change its status (e.g. In Progress, Resolved) as you act on it.
Tenants receive a rent due notification, and you are paid as soon as a payment is verified. Track collected and pending amounts on your Dashboard.
